# Give the machine a chance, human experts ain’t that great…

*AI & Society* 40(2), 1155–1156 · first published online 2024 · Free to read

Argues that the policy-relevant comparison is between LLMs and real human expertise, with its biases and conflicts of interest, rather than an idealized version of it.
